''After several <strike>anonam</strike> <strike>anynom</strike> <strike>anemon</strike> un-attributed edits'', I decided to get an account.&nbsp; This probably means that I will never make another edit.&nbsp; Life is like that, sometimes. 

''I do grammarye'', spellynge and editynge for style.&nbsp; If you would like me to look at an article, leave a note on my talk page and I'll try to get to it. &nbsp;I&nbsp;make no promises, but I will do my best.&nbsp; Be aware that I'm pathologically incapable of writing in anything other than an English idiom.&nbsp; If I were any more English, I would be incapacitated. 

''Were I to be asked my opinion'', I would say that the future subjunctive is used less than it should be.
